title: Traditional Saudi Arabian Oats Porridge
description: A warm and comforting porridge made with oats and spices, inspired by the flavors of Saudi Arabia. Perfect for a cold winter morning.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the oats, salt, cinnamon, and ginger. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally.
Cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and the porridge has a creamy consistency.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
